summary: completion acceptance is governed by Nghị định 06/2021 as amended by 35/2023 and 175/2024
certain works are subject to competent construction-authority inspection/acceptance requirements
handover/operation/maintenance documentation belongs to the completion state
COMPLETION_ACCEPTANCE.scope_guard: Exact procedure depends on project/work classification; do not treat every private small house as requiring identical authority acceptance workflow.

FIRE.summary: Where fire-design/acceptance obligations apply, operation before required acceptance is not permitted.

WATER.summary: Domestic water quality/readiness is independent of ritual date.

VENTILATION.summary: Ventilation/HVAC readiness belongs to habitability/function, not 'opening qi'.
